verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Cal.com's API/MCP server enabling AI agents to check availability, create bookings, and manage event types — but this is about external agents *acting on* Cal.com data, not the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's scheduling data (e.g., analytics, pattern detection, smart recommendations) within its own UI. No such in-product AI insights feature is mentioned anywhere in the pack.
